name: HFE detail-emphasis exponential integrator (hfe_s1..s8, hfe_auto)
plain: A 2-stage exponential integrator in log-sigma (res_2s form) that takes the difference between the two stage predictions, keeps only its high-frequency part (value minus a 3x3 box blur) and adds a scaled copy to the second stage before the step. hfe_s1 has zero boost, so it is a plain 2-stage step with c2=0.45; s2..s8 raise the boost and move c2 towards 0.80. The boost is off for the first quarter of the steps, ramps in by 55%, and is capped at 35% of the second stage's RMS. hfe_auto instead ramps c2 and the boost with sigma and shuts the boost off when the difference is already rich in fine detail; 3, 4 and 5-stage versions exist but only through ManualSampler's stages input.
math:
Symbols: x latent; σ_i current sigma; σ_{i+1} next; h = ln(σ_i/σ_{i+1}); D(·,σ) model x0 prediction; φ1(h)=(1−e^{−h})/h; φ2(h)=(e^{−h}−1+h)/h²; N steps.
E1 = D(x,σ_i) − x; X2 = x + h·c2·φ1(c2h)·E1; E2 = D(X2, σ_i e^{−c2 h}) − x.
Δ = E2 − E1; HF(Δ) = Δ − box_k(Δ) (reflect-padded k×k mean, k=3).
g_i = clip((i/(N−1) − 0.25)/0.30, 0, 1); B = η g_i HF(Δ); if rms(B) > 0.35 rms(E2) then B ← B·0.35 rms(E2)/rms(B).
x ← x + h(b1 E1 + b2 (E2 + B)), b2 = φ2/c2, b1 = φ1 − b2. Last step: x ← D(x,σ_i).
Presets hfe_sL, L=1..8: t=(L−1)/7, η = 0.48 t^1.5, c2 = 0.45 + 0.35 t.
hfe_auto: p = 1 − σ_i/σ_0; c2 = 0.45 + 0.40 p; k = 5 if p < 0.5 else 3; η_i = η_peak·(3p² − 2p³)·max(0, 1 − 2‖HF(Δ)‖²/‖Δ‖²); η_peak = 0.55 for 2 stages (0.275, 0.183, 0.138 for 3, 4, 5).
stages 3..5: fixed res_3s/4s/5s tableaux, boost on (E_last − E1) added to the last stage; preset default η is divided by (stages−1).

props.extra_model_calls: 1 per step at stages=2 (stages−1 extra when stages 3..5 are picked in ManualSampler)
props.params: eta (preset default 0 at s1 to 0.48 at s8), c2 (0.45 to 0.80), stages=2 (2..5 only via ManualSampler); hfe_auto: eta=-1 means calibrated peak, c2_start=0.45, c2_end=0.85
props.nan_guard: on NaN/inf it zeroes the boost for the rest of the run
